		set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_m58_debt_status value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_m58_debt_audit_state value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_m58_debt_settled_by value = root }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_m58_debt_settled_cycle value = root.var:zg361_review_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_m58_debt_performance_sink value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_m58_debt_consumer_status value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_cp_policy_debt_open_n add = -1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_cp_policy_debt_settled_n add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Exact settled replay is audit-only and never reaches the KPI sink again.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_cp_m58_debt_status
			has_variable = zg361_cp_m58_debt_settled_by
			has_variable = zg361_cp_m58_debt_settled_cycle
			var:zg361_cp_m58_debt_status = 2
			var:zg361_cp_m58_debt_settled_by = root
			root = { has_variable = zg361_review_serial }
			root.var:zg361_review_serial >= var:zg361_cp_m58_debt_settled_cycle
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_m58_debt_consumer_status value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# A complete exact debt that is not due is future input, never current work.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_cp_m58_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_cp_m58_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_cp_m58_debt_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_cp_m58_debt_status
			var:zg361_cp_m58_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_cp_m58_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_cp_m58_debt_subject = this
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			root = { has_variable = zg361_review_serial }
			root.var:zg361_review_serial < var:zg361_cp_m58_debt_due_cycle
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_m58_debt_consumer_status value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Pending but non-exact means stale/cross-owner/corrupt identity: fail closed.
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_cp_m58_debt_status var:zg361_cp_m58_debt_status = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_m58_debt_consumer_status value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_last_red_code value = 60058 }
	}
}
